comment: Drug interactions aligned with BNF/BNFc and other reputable formularies (Stockley's, Lexicomp). Severity: contraindicated | major | moderate | minor. Always verify in current BNF/BNFc before clinical decisions.

interactions.description: Increased bleeding risk. Avoid or use with caution; consider gastroprotection and monitoring.

Amiodarone potentiates warfarin. Reduce warfarin dose; monitor INR closely.
Fluconazole potentiates warfarin. Reduce warfarin dose; monitor INR.
Trimethoprim may potentiate warfarin. Monitor INR.
PPIs may alter warfarin effect in some patients. Monitor INR if starting/stopping.
Increased risk of methotrexate toxicity (blood dyscrasia). Avoid or use with extreme caution; monitor FBC.
Co-trimoxazole contains trimethoprim; increased methotrexate toxicity. Avoid.
NSAIDs can reduce methotrexate clearance. Use with caution; monitor FBC and LFT.
NSAIDs can increase lithium levels. Monitor lithium levels; consider dose reduction.

Serotonin syndrome risk. Do not combine; allow washout (e.g. 2 weeks) between switching.
Serotonin syndrome risk. Allow 2 weeks after MAOI before starting SSRI.
Serotonin syndrome risk. Allow 5 weeks after fluoxetine before MAOI.
Increased risk of serotonin syndrome. Use with caution; lower doses; monitor.
Serotonin syndrome risk. Use with caution; consider alternative analgesic.
Risk of severe hyperkalaemia. Avoid potassium supplements with potassium-sparing diuretics unless monitored.
Risk of hyperkalaemia. Avoid unless monitored.
Ibuprofen can reduce antiplatelet effect of aspirin if taken before aspirin. Space doses.
NSAID may reduce cardioprotective effect of aspirin. Consider timing or alternative.
Clarithromycin increases statin levels (myopathy risk). Avoid with simvastatin; use pravastatin/rosuvastatin or pause statin.
Clarithromycin greatly increases simvastatin levels. Avoid combination; use alternative antibiotic or statin.
Carbamazepine reduces contraceptive efficacy. Use non-enzyme-inducing method or higher-dose pill.
Amiodarone can increase digoxin levels. Reduce digoxin dose; monitor levels.
Risk of lactic acidosis with iodinated contrast. Stop metformin before and after procedure per local protocol.
Calcium reduces doxycycline absorption. Space by 2–3 hours.
Antacids reduce doxycycline absorption. Space by 2–3 hours.
Increased GI bleeding risk. Use PPI if combination needed.
Increased GI bleeding risk. Consider PPI.
Risk of hyperkalaemia. Avoid potassium supplements unless monitored.
Risk of severe hyperkalaemia. Avoid potassium supplements unless monitored.
Rifampicin reduces contraceptive efficacy. Use alternative contraception or higher-dose pill; barrier method.
Fluconazole increases simvastatin levels (myopathy risk). Avoid or use low-dose fluconazole; consider pravastatin.
Verapamil increases simvastatin levels. Limit simvastatin dose (e.g. 20 mg) or use alternative statin.
Diltiazem increases simvastatin levels. Limit simvastatin dose or use alternative statin.
Allopurinol increases azathioprine toxicity. Reduce azathioprine dose (e.g. to 25%); monitor FBC.
NSAIDs can increase nephrotoxicity and reduce ciclosporin clearance. Use with caution; monitor renal function.
